properties.description: Eleven real-binary tests, isolated HOME, a deadline per run: in a project whose .mcp.json names the export, a writing call keeps it current (one stderr line naming the path and the config; compare_designs live-vs-export and fresh-export-vs-kept both identical); a read (get_node, loop_status, graph_report) and a refused write leave the file's bytes and mtime untouched; --export-to names the file and wins over the configuration, and a read with it writes nothing; .vscode/mcp.json with ${workspaceFolder} is read; with nothing named anywhere a write says so and writes none; disagreeing configurations are refused with no store and no export; a merge-mangled export is left alone, exit 3, the write landed; an unwritable export (no folder) exit 3; --no-export writes none and says the export is behind, and is refused with --export-to; in git, two door writes each chain prev_content_hash from the COMMITTED export; a pointer folder still refuses (item 1) with or without --export-to.
properties.name: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_writing_call_keeps_the_committed_export_current.rs — eleven real-binary tests of the door's export
